business_problem: Arrive needed to unify analytics across multiple acquisitions and BI tools so the company could establish one trusted mobility-data model and scale support for users without growing the central analytics team proportionally.
solution_summary: Arrive uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Arrive needed to unify analytics across multiple acquisitions and BI tools so the company could establish one trusted mobility-data model and scale support for users without growing the central analytics team proportionally. Looker acts as the centralized analytics hub and certified global data-model layer for the company, serving as the serving layer. Looker API automates content migration, instance transitions, and internal admin tooling across acquisitions, serving as the serving layer. Data from acquired businesses and different operational systems is unified through certified global models in Looker, Looker API-driven tooling automates migration and governance tasks, and the same foundation is being extended toward conversational support inside internal collaboration channels. The implementation integrates with PowerBI, Tableau, Confluence, Jira, Slack.
